items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: From then on, we got along very well with Smith.

ctx.x: And that was it. From then on, we got along very well with Smith. He got the point after awhile, because we broke up, the whole bar broke up and they just -- it was just too much.
So when did you come back to Chicago? And what were the circumstances? What had been happening in Chicago from what we'd been talking about earlier?
